subject: hoverPickup
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: militarized pickup converted to hover thrusters.
Style: low-poly cyberpunk.
reasoning:
I'm planning a single TypeScript module for a static hovering pickup truck model, sketching rough dimensions (~5.4m long, 2m wide, 1.9m tall) and deciding to use the builder's part, loft, extrude, and lathe utilities without joints since the vehicle is static.

I'm figuring out the hover height so the lowest thruster pads sit near y=0, then blocking out the chassis, hood, cab, and bed using boxes and extruded side profiles, applying panelled metal paint kits for the armor plating.

Mapping out the side profile points for the lower body silhouette, defining the bed floor, cab, and roofline as separate narrower extrusions...

I'm positioning the windshield plane with the right tilt and sizing, then adding armor plates, bed walls with a roll bar and turret mount, rocket pods, a front bullbar with glowing lights, and ducted-fan hover thruster housings at each wheel position.

Now I'm detailing the thruster pods with cyan underglow discs, rotating fan blade boxes, mounting arms connecting them to the body, magenta neon side strips, and a stenciled "HVR-7" decal plus hazard markings for texture.

I'm also planning extra details—antenna, roof lightbar glowing red/blue, headlights and taillights, hover vents, mirrors, and cargo like fuel cans and a glowing crate—then writing helper functions for boxes, decals, and mirrored placement, along with paint definitions for olive camo and cyan neon materials.

Now I'm working out the geometry for pod shapes, lathing a flared shell outline from a small vertical profile and adding a downward-facing glow disc near its base.

For the fan assembly, I'm placing a hub cylinder with six box-shaped blades arranged radially and rotated to fan outward, then connecting arms linking the pods to the central body with struts for structural detail.

Now I'm sketching the turret setup with a ring base, pedestal, gun housing, and twin barrels rotated into firing position, plus a shield plate, and I'm adding rocket pods with small dark cylindrical tubes on the bed walls to suggest ammunition ports.

I'm positioning the pods on the bed rails, deciding whether tubes should face front or rear, then placing the bed walls as side boxes spanning the vehicle's length.

Now I'm adding the tailgate box, roll bar tubes, and then shifting to the front end — building a bullbar with vertical rods and a crossbar, plus glow-box headlights positioned near the front face with a slight slope.

Placing the headlight boxes and grille with glow slits along the sloped front face, then adding hazard-stripe texture to the front bumper box.

Now I'm adding side details: thin magenta neon strips along x=±1.01, a cyan underglow strip beneath the body, and door decal planes positioned near the cab's side edge for a "07" number and kanji emblem, making sure the text orientation reads correctly when mirrored on the opposite side.

I'm placing the lower body decals since the door area near the windows is too narrow -- putting the "HV-07" label and a kanji emblem on the hood/lower side panel at x≈±1.01, y≈0.85, sized around 0.9x0.3.

For the hood decal, I'm figuring out the orientation so it reads correctly: the plane sits flat on the hood top (y≈1.21) with the drawing axis set to z and an up vector along [0,0,1], so the text faces forward and can be read by someone approaching from the front rather than upside-down from behind.

Moving past the orientation details, I'm sketching out remaining details to add: antenna, lightbar, mirrors, exhaust vents, spare fuel cans, a crate with a screen texture, angled armor plates on the cab doors, a skid plate, and twin rear vector-thruster cylinders at the back of the vehicle.

I'm also planning a sensor dome on the cab roof, a texture list covering hazard stripes, plates, emblem, screen, and camo mottling, and making sure the part helper function supports glow, textures, and rotation consistently before writing the final code.

Still positioning cab geometry...
